original_registry_entry.issuing_organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
original_registry_entry.version: UK Kidney Association guideline, published 5 April 2023, review date 5 April 2028
original_registry_entry.jurisdiction: United Kingdom; international specialty guidance requiring UAE adaptation
original_registry_entry.population: Adults receiving or preparing for haemodialysis and their dialysis access care teams.
original_registry_entry.clinical_setting: Nephrology, haemodialysis and vascular-access assessment and follow-up.
original_registry_entry.applicability_note: Exact for documenting haemodialysis access type, access examination, dysfunction or complication context, access planning and clinician-entered follow-up. It does not prescribe dialysis settings or diagnose access failure.

exact_sections.heading: Vascular access guideline — access assessment and monitoring
exact_sections.locator: official guideline PDF, relevant vascular-access assessment and monitoring recommendations
exact_sections.evidence_summary: Supports documenting access type, access history, examination findings, flow or dysfunction observations and clinician interpretation without inferring access status.

exact_sections.heading: Vascular access guideline — access planning and creation
exact_sections.locator: official guideline PDF, access planning and creation recommendations
exact_sections.evidence_summary: Supports documenting access planning, referral context, access maturation or intervention history and patient discussion.

exact_sections.heading: Vascular access guideline — complications and follow-up
exact_sections.locator: official guideline PDF, complication surveillance and follow-up recommendations
exact_sections.evidence_summary: Supports documenting bleeding, infection, thrombosis, stenosis, aneurysm or other access concerns and clinician-entered escalation or follow-up.
